title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether to Distinguish between Principals and Accessories concerning the Directly Responsible Supervisors and Other Directly Responsible Persons in the Trial of Crimes Committed by Entities

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2000] No. 31

Hubei Higher People's Court:

Your Court's Request No. E Gao Fa [1999] 374 regarding the issue of whether to distinguish between principal and accessory offenders for 'directly responsible supervisors' and 'other directly responsible persons' in cases of unit crime of letter of credit fraud has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:

When adjudicating cases of unit intentional crimes, for the directly responsible supervisors and other directly responsible persons, it is permissible not to distinguish between principal and accessory offenders, and punishments shall be imposed according to the roles they played in the unit crime.

This is our reply.
